scripts.setup: npm run setup:env && npm run setup:tools && npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.db:migration:add: dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate --project backend/Cinema.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/Cinema.Api
scripts.db:migration:remove: dotnet ef migrations remove --project backend/Cinema.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/Cinema.Api
scripts.db:migration:list: dotnet ef migrations list --project backend/Cinema.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/Cinema.Api
scripts.db:migration:script: dotnet ef migrations script --project backend/Cinema.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/Cinema.Api --output backend/migration.sql
scripts.db:update: dotnet ef database update --project backend/Cinema.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/Cinema.Api
scripts.db:drop: dotnet ef database drop --project backend/Cinema.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/Cinema.Api --force
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:drop && npm run db:update
scripts.db:rebuild: npm run db:drop && npm run db:migration:add && npm run db:update
scripts.db:dbcontext:info: dotnet ef dbcontext info --project backend/Cinema.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/Cinema.Api
scripts.test:backend: dotnet test backend/tests/Cinema.UnitTests && dotnet test backend/tests/Cinema.IntegrationTests
scripts.test:load: npm run test:load:browse && npm run test:load:peak
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:load
